items.title: I think last night was the best I've ever seen Kris Murray play. He hit some shots, but his defense on Brandon Miller was outstanding. Miller was just 2-for-10 with Murray as the primary defender.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
I think last night was the best I've ever seen Kris Murray play. He hit some shots, but his defense on Brandon Miller was outstanding. Miller was just 2-for-10 with Murray as the primary defender.

Murray is getting a chance to step up with Cam Boozer out. Great first step!
